qualifier: biotin-dependent carboxylase and biotin cycle defects
name: Leucine catabolism and biotin-dependent carboxylase inborn errors
rationale: Members are leucine-pathway organic acidemias (isovaleric, 3-MCC, 3-MGA, beta-ketothiolase) and biotin recycling/holocarboxylase defects; the biotin cycle (BTD, HLCS, biotin transport) is what the valine/isoleucine-oriented confusables lack.

qualifier: K-ATP channels, incretins and fatty-acid receptors
name: Beta-cell insulin secretion regulated by K-ATP channels and incretins
rationale: Members cover insulin processing and stimulus-secretion control in beta cells (K-ATP/ABCC8/9, TALK channels, GLP-1/GIP, FFAR1, neurotransmitters); confusables instead centre on insulin receptor signalling, GLUT4 translocation or glucagon receptors.

name: Golgi glycosylation substrate transporter defects
rationale: Members are nucleotide-sugar, sulfate and acetyl-CoA transporter defects supplying Golgi glycosylation/sulfation plus UDP-glucuronate formation; confusables focus on sugar biosynthesis, GPI anchors, PAPS or fucose metabolism rather than transport.

name: Rho-driven cytokinetic ring and filopodial actin organization
rationale: Members span contractile ring, cleavage furrow, septin ring and citron kinase alongside filopodium regulation and cell-shape polarity; cytokinesis distinguishes it from the RND/semaphorin, actin-network and dendritic-spine confusables.

name: NF-kappaB transcription factor activity regulation
rationale: All members regulate NF-kappaB or generic DNA-binding transcription factor activity, including negative regulation of canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB; confusables instead concern cytokine/TLR suppression, TNFR1 signalling or deubiquitination.

qualifier: pharyngeal, placodal glands and otic structures
name: Ear and glandular organ morphogenesis
rationale: Members are morphogenesis of placode- and pharyngeal-derived organs (thyroid, parathyroid, thymus, salivary, lacrimal, mammary glands, papillae, spleen) and of the inner, middle and outer ear; confusables carry face, limb and palate or airway/bile duct development instead.

name: Ear development and vestibular-auditory mechanosensation
rationale: Members cover otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canal, otolith and hair-cell fate together with balance, gravity and sound detection; confusables lack the vestibular/hearing function terms and carry olfactory, cranial nerve, eye or stereocilia content.

core: Potassium leak channels setting resting potential
name: Two-pore-domain and Ca2+-activated K+ channels in resting potential
rationale: Members are K2P families (TWIK, TREK, TASK, THIK, TRESK) and Ca2+-activated K+ channels with resting potential and hyperpolarization regulation; confusables carry K-ATP channels, sodium transport, TALK/acid sensing or smooth muscle contraction.

core: Mitotic chromosome and nuclear envelope dynamics
qualifier: condensation, cohesion establishment, CENP-A deposition, envelope reassembly
name: Mitotic chromosome condensation, cohesion and nuclear envelope remodeling
rationale: Members cover chromosome condensation, cohesin loading/establishment, CENP-A deposition and nuclear envelope disassembly/ESCRT-III resealing and abscission; confusables emphasise spindle/centrosome control, cohesion resolution, meiosis or histone acetylation.

qualifier: cytochrome and sulfonation metabolism of drugs and steroids
name: Drug and steroid xenobiotic biotransformation
rationale: Members are drug disposition (aspirin, atorvastatin, ciprofloxacin, prednisone), steroid, flavone and cytochrome metabolism and cytosolic sulfonation; confusables carry organic anion transport/bilirubin conjugation or mycotoxin detoxification.

qualifier: DNA replication, repair and nuclear envelope targets
name: SUMOylation of genome-maintenance and nuclear envelope proteins
rationale: Members are SUMOylation of DNA replication, DNA repair, nuclear envelope, ubiquitination and SUMO-machinery proteins plus Ran-mediated mitosis; confusables cover RNA-binding/transcription factor targets or SUMO processing and conjugation steps.

core: MHC class II and CD1 antigen presentation
name: MHC-II and CD1 antigen presentation with NKT cell regulation
rationale: Members cover exogenous peptide presentation via MHC class II, CD1 lipid antigen presentation, TLR7/8-MHC modules and NKT activation/differentiation; confusables emphasise MHC class I cross-presentation, proteasome or dendritic/monocyte surface signatures.

core: Epigenetic silencing by DNA and histone methylation
name: DNA and histone methylation in imprinting and X inactivation
rationale: Members are DNA methylation, PRC2/MLL histone lysine methylation and demethylation, imprinting, random X inactivation and facultative heterochromatin; confusables carry CHD/NuRD remodelling, histone deacetylation or non-histone methylation.

name: Sphingomyelin hydrolysis and ceramide homeostasis regulation
rationale: Members concern sphingomyelinase-driven ceramide production and regulation of ceramide/sphingolipid levels; confusables cover glycosphingolipid metabolism, ER-Golgi lipid transfer or de novo sphingolipid synthesis.

name: Intermembrane lipid transfer and aminophospholipid flipping
rationale: Members are intermembrane transfer of PI, PC, glycolipids and ceramide-1-phosphate plus P4-ATPase/TMEM30A flippase translocation; confusables carry ER tubular network shaping, scrambling, Rab prenylation or phospholipid catabolism.

name: BMP-SMAD regulation of vasculogenesis and endothelial differentiation
rationale: Members combine BMP/SMAD signalling regulation with vasculogenesis, arterial/venous vessel morphogenesis, endothelial differentiation and vessel maturation; confusables centre on cardiac conduction, heart chamber/valve morphogenesis or cardiomyocyte growth.

name: Ubiquitin-mediated degradation of p53 and checkpoint regulators
rationale: All three members are ubiquitin-dependent turnover of DNA damage checkpoint regulators (p53, phosphorylated Cdc25A, COP1); confusables carry checkpoint signalling, G2/M or G1/S kinase events instead of degradation.

name: KIR-mediated NK cell regulation and peripheral tolerance
rationale: Members cover KIR/activating NK receptor modules, regulation of NK activation and cytokine production, inhibition of T-cell cytotoxicity and peripheral tolerance; confusables emphasise MHC-Ib presentation, degranulation or dendritic/T-cell costimulation.

qualifier: vitamins E and K and ubiquinol
name: Vitamin E, vitamin K and ubiquinol metabolism
rationale: Members are vitamin E transport/metabolism, vitamin K and menaquinone catabolism and ubiquinol/quinone biosynthesis; confusables carry cholesterol/mevalonate synthesis or vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation.

name: Mitochondrial translation, tRNA aminoacylation and wobble modification
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial translation initiation/elongation/termination, cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging and wobble-base modification; confusables emphasise tRNA processing, mitochondrial transcription or mtDNA maintenance.

qualifier: dorsoventral axis and neural plate border specification
name: Dorsoventral patterning and neural plate border specification
rationale: Members cover anterior/posterior neural plate formation, neural plate border and neural crest fate, dorsoventral axis specification and boundary formation; confusables carry axial mesoderm/notochord or hindbrain segmentation instead.

name: Rho GTPase-driven leading-edge actin and lamellipodial motility
rationale: Members span the Rho/Rac/Cdc42 GTPase cycles and their effectors with Arp2/3 nucleation, lamellipodia, ruffles, podosomes and macropinocytosis; confusables carry focal adhesion IPP, ROCK/PAK/citron effectors or filopodia/cytokinesis.

name: RNA polymerase II pausing and elongation control
rationale: Members cover Pol II promoter clearance, pausing, elongation complex formation and elongation-coupled chromatin remodelling; confusables carry RNA processing, Pol I/III transcription, HIV transcription or initiation and termination.

name: FGFR3 signalling cascades and FGFR-PI3K activation
rationale: Members are FGFR3 ligand binding, mutant activation and PLC/FRS/SHC cascades plus the PI3K cascade from all four FGFRs; confusables carry the FRS/SHC/PLC cascades of FGFR1/2/4 or Klotho binding.

name: Activin-FSH axis in gonadotropin secretion and testis development
rationale: Members cover activin signalling and follistatin antagonism, glycoprotein hormones, LH/FSH secretion and FSH response, and Sertoli/seminiferous tubule development; confusables emphasise ovarian follicle, ovulation and Leydig or meiotic events.
